# Every setting, what a project's file may do with it, and whether it is enforced.
# Generated by the test `every_key_has_a_trust_class`. A change here is a change in
# what a repository can do to its user: review it as one.
config_version                     preference
profile                            user only
managed.locked                     user only
model.main                         raises cost
model.fast                         raises cost
model.judge                        raises cost
model.effort                       raises cost
model.reasoning                    preference
model.max_output                   raises cost
model.speed                        by value: `standard` is a preference, any other tier raises cost
